universe: fundamental screen (market cap > $2B, ADV > 2M shares, relative strength > 0) over the event-driven watchlist
entry_rule: technical breakout above the 20-day band with RVOL above threshold AND a fresh catalyst/news within the recency window AND the fundamental screen passed
exit_rule: bracket: stop = entry - ATR*stop_mult, take-profit = entry + ATR*tp_mult
signal_bar: t (breakout/news confirmed at close of day t)
sizing: risk-based; sector cap + sector rotation; 1% max-loss-per-trade; hardcoded caps never relaxed
benchmark: buy & hold SPY with identical friction
notes: P3 executes bracket MARKET entries (highest-slippage path), modeled here as next_open for backtesting. Each NEW catalyst pattern must be formalized as its own spec and backtested vs buy&hold-with-friction (Teaching Five) before it is allowed to place orders. The movers/most-active funnel widening reuses this same fundamental screen — the quality bar is held constant.
